author: neal_illustrator
title: Hiring artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Kirim CV & Portofolio ke: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subjek: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Dibuka sampai semua posisi terisi.

author: johnnymurrayproduction
title: Looking for visual co-author / illustrator for musical podcast
content: Johnny Murray Production is now looking for a VISUAL CO-AUTHOR. Looking for Animation Directors, Visual Storytellers, Animators, Illustrators, Motion Designers, VFX Artists. First visual pilot: Mundus Imaginalis. Interested? Send your portfolio / showreel.

author: attenboroughac
title: Hiring artist to paint floral exhibition mural
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Commission fee £750. Materials provided. Duration 3 days: 28-30 September 2026. Location Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Send bio, portfolio to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21st September 2026.
